the\n//             per-step closest-point search is a block-wide reduction.\n//\n// Arithmetic and tie-breaking follow the sequential algorithm exactly, so the\n// clusters produced are identical to the sequential version.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <utility>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                   \\\n    do {                                                                   \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                         \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                         \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__, \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                             \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                  \\\n        }                                                                  \\\n    } while (0)\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Threads per block for the candidate-growth kernel (must be a power of two)\nconstexpr int BLOCK_SIZE = 256;\n\n// Upper bound on per-device scratch memory used for candidate distance state\nconstexpr size_t SCRATCH_BUDGET_BYTES = size_t{256} << 20;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Best candidate found so far: a cluster cardinality and the seed producing it\nstruct Candidate {\n    int cardinality;\n    int seed;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Squared Euclidean distance. Shared by host and device code so that both\n// evaluate exactly the same floating-point expression.\n__host__ __device__ inline double squaredDistance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return dx * dx + dy * dy;\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    return sqrt(squaredDistance(p1, p2));\n}\n\n// Grow a candidate cluster from seed_point. At each step the unclustered point\n// with the smallest maximum distance to the current members is added (lowest\n// index wins ties), as long as that maximum distance is below the threshold.\n// max_dist[c] is maintained incrementally, which yields exactly the value that\n// a full recomputation over all members would give. Returns the members in\n// insertion order.\nstd::vector<int> growCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                                      const std::vector<uint8_t>& clustered,\n                                      const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                      const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n\n    // A negative value marks a point that can no longer be a candidate\n    std::vector<double> max_dist(N, 0.0);\n    for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n        if (clustered[c]) max_dist[c] = -1.0;\n    }\n    max_dist[seed_point] = -1.0;\n\n    std::vector<int> members{seed_point};\n    int added = seed_point;\n    while (true) {\n        for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n            if (max_dist[c] >= 0.0) {\n                max_dist[c] = std::max(max_dist[c], distance(points[c], points[added]));\n            }\n        }\n\n        int closest = -1;\n        double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n            if (max_dist[c] >= 0.0 && max_dist[c] < threshold && max_dist[c] < min_diameter) {\n                min_diameter = max_dist[c];\n                closest = c;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        members.push_back(closest);\n        max_dist[closest] = -1.0;\n        added = closest;\n    }\n\n    return members;\n}\n\n// Device-side counterpart of growCandidateCluster(): block b grows the candidate\n// cluster of seeds[b] and writes its cardinality to cardinalities[b]. Working\n// state for block b lives in max_dist_scratch[b * N ... b * N + N - 1].\n__global__ void candidateCardinalityKernel(const Point* points, const uint8_t* clustered,\n                                           const int N, const double threshold,\n                                           const int* seeds, double* max_dist_scratch,\n                                           int* cardinalities) {\n    __shared__ double red_dist[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int red_idx[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int added;\n\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int seed = seeds[b];\n    double* max_dist = max_dist_scratch + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n\n    for (int c = tid; c < N; c += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        max_dist[c] = (clustered[c] || c == seed) ? -1.0 : 0.0;\n    }\n    if (tid == 0) added = seed;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    int cardinality = 1;\n    while (true) {\n        // Fold the most recently added member into every candidate's max distance\n        const Point& last = points[added];\n        for (int c = tid; c < N; c += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n            if (max_dist[c] >= 0.0) {\n                max_dist[c] = fmax(max_dist[c], distance(points[c], last));\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Per-thread search for the closest admissible candidate\n        double best_dist = 0.0;\n        int best = -1;\n        for (int c = tid; c < N; c += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n            const double d = max_dist[c];\n            if (d >= 0.0 && d < threshold &&\n                (best < 0 || d < best_dist || (d == best_dist && c < best))) {\n                best_dist = d;\n                best = c;\n            }\n        }\n        red_dist[tid] = best_dist;\n        red_idx[tid] = best;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Block-wide reduction: smallest distance wins, lowest index breaks ties\n        for (int s = BLOCK_SIZE / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n            if (tid < s) {\n                const int mi = red_idx[tid];\n                const int oi = red_idx[tid + s];\n                const double md = red_dist[tid];\n                const double od = red_dist[tid + s];\n                if (oi >= 0 && (mi < 0 || od < md || (od == md && oi < mi))) {\n                    red_dist[tid] = od;\n                    red_idx[tid] = oi;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        if (red_idx[0] < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            added = red_idx[0];\n            max_dist[added] = -1.0;\n        }\n        cardinality++;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) cardinalities[b] = cardinality;\n}\n\n// Upper bound on the cardinality of the candidate cluster of seeds[b]: every\n// member other than the seed lies strictly within the threshold of the seed, so\n// 1 + (number of such unclustered points) bounds the cluster size.\n__global__ void neighborhoodBoundKernel(const Point* points, const uint8_t* clustered,\n                                        const int N, const double threshold,\n                                        const int* seeds, int* bounds) {\n    __shared__ int count;\n\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int seed = seeds[b];\n\n    if (tid == 0) count = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    int local = 0;\n    for (int c = tid; c < N; c += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        if (!clustered[c] && c != seed && distance(points[c], points[seed]) < threshold) {\n            local++;\n        }\n    }\n    atomicAdd(&count, local);\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    if (tid == 0) bounds[b] = count + 1;\n}\n\n// Per-GPU state, owned by exactly one OpenMP thread during evaluation\nstruct DeviceWorker {\n    int device = 0;\n    Point* d_points = nullptr;\n    uint8_t* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_cardinalities = nullptr;\n    double* d_scratch = nullptr;\n    size_t batch_capacity = 0;\n    std::vector<int> h_cardinalities;\n};\n\n// Choose the GPUs this MPI rank drives. Ranks sharing a node split the node's\n// devices round-robin; every rank gets at least one device.\nstd::vector<int> selectDevices(MPI_Comm node_comm) {\n    int ndev = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&ndev));\n    if (ndev == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    int local_rank = 0;\n    int local_size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(node_comm, &local_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(node_comm, &local_size);\n\n    std::vector<int> devices;\n    for (int d = local_rank; d < ndev; d += local_size) {\n        devices.push_back(d);\n    }\n    if (devices.empty()) {\n        devices.push_back(local_rank % ndev);\n    }\n    return devices;\n}\n\n// Allocate device buffers and upload the (read-only) point set to each device\nstd::vector<DeviceWorker> createWorkers(const std::vector<int>& devices,\n                                        const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                        const size_t max_owned) {\n    const size_t N = points.size();\n    const size_t max_batch = std::max<size_t>(1, SCRATCH_BUDGET_BYTES / (N * sizeof(double)));\n    const size_t batch = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min(max_batch, max_owned));\n\n    std::vector<DeviceWorker> workers(devices.size());\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < devices.size(); ++t) {\n        DeviceWorker& w = workers[t];\n        w.device = devices[t];\n        w.batch_capacity = batch;\n        w.h_cardinalities.assign(batch, 0);\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(w.device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&w.d_points, N * sizeof(Point)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&w.d_clustered, N * sizeof(uint8_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&w.d_seeds, batch * sizeof(int)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&w.d_cardinalities, batch * sizeof(int)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&w.d_scratch, batch * N * sizeof(double)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(w.d_points, points.data(), N * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n    return workers;\n}\n\nvoid destroyWorkers(std::vector<DeviceWorker>& workers) {\n    for (DeviceWorker& w : workers) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(w.device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(w.d_points));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(w.d_clustered));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(w.d_seeds));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(w.d_cardinalities));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(w.d_scratch));\n    }\n}\n\n// True if (card, seed) should replace the current best: larger cardinality wins\n// and ties go to the lower seed index, matching the sequential scan order\ninline bool isBetter(const int cardinality, const int seed, const Candidate& best) {\n    return cardinality > best.cardinality ||\n           (cardinality == best.cardinality && seed < best.seed);\n}\n\n// Evaluate the cardinality of the candidate cluster for every seed in `active`,\n// split across this rank's GPUs (one OpenMP thread per device), and return the\n// best candidate found.\nCandidate evaluateActiveSeeds(std::vector<DeviceWorker>& workers,\n                              const std::vector<int>& active,\n                              const std::vector<uint8_t>& clustered,\n                              const double threshold) {\n    Candidate result{-1, -1};\n    if (active.empty()) return result;\n\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(clustered.size());\n    const int T = static_cast<int>(workers.size());\n    const size_t n = active.size();\n    std::vector<Candidate> per_worker(T, Candidate{-1, -1});\n\n    #pragma omp parallel num_threads(T)\n    {\n        const int t = omp_get_thread_num();\n        DeviceWorker& w = workers[t];\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(w.device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(w.d_clustered, clustered.data(), N * sizeof(uint8_t),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        const size_t lo = n * t / T;\n        const size_t hi = n * (t + 1) / T;\n        const size_t count = hi - lo;\n\n        // Cardinality upper bound of each seed, computed on the device\n        // (d_cardinalities is reused as scratch for the bounds)\n        std::vector<int> bound(count);\n        for (size_t off = 0; off < count; off += w.batch_capacity) {\n            const int m = static_cast<int>(std::min(w.batch_capacity, count - off));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(w.d_seeds, active.data() + lo + off, m * sizeof(int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            neighborhoodBoundKernel<<<m, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(w.d_points, w.d_clustered, N, threshold,\n                                                       w.d_seeds, w.d_cardinalities);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(bound.data() + off, w.d_cardinalities, m * sizeof(int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        // Visit seeds by decreasing bound (ties: lower seed first). Once a seed\n        // cannot beat the best candidate, no later seed can either.\n        std::vector<size_t> order(count);\n        std::iota(order.begin(), order.end(), size_t{0});\n        std::sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](size_t a, size_t b) {\n            if (bound[a] != bound[b]) return bound[a] > bound[b];\n            return active[lo + a] < active[lo + b];\n        });\n\n        Candidate local{-1, -1};\n        std::vector<int> batch;\n        size_t pos = 0;\n        while (pos < count) {\n            // Gather the next batch of seeds that could still win\n            batch.clear();\n            while (pos < count && batch.size() < w.batch_capacity) {\n                const size_t i = order[pos];\n                const int seed = active[lo + i];\n                if (bound[i] < local.cardinality ||\n                    (bound[i] == local.cardinality && seed > local.seed)) {\n                    pos = count; // Every remaining seed is pruned as well\n                    break;\n                }\n                batch.push_back(seed);\n                ++pos;\n            }\n            if (batch.empty()) break;\n\n            const int m = static_cast<int>(batch.size());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(w.d_seeds, batch.data(), m * sizeof(int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            candidateCardinalityKernel<<<m, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(w.d_points, w.d_clustered, N, threshold,\n                                                          w.d_seeds, w.d_scratch,\n                                                          w.d_cardinalities);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(w.h_cardinalities.data(), w.d_cardinalities, m * sizeof(int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {\n                if (isBetter(w.h_cardinalities[i], batch[i], local)) {\n                    local = Candidate{w.h_cardinalities[i], batch[i]};\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        per_worker[t] = local;\n    }\n\n    for (const Candidate& c : per_worker) {\n        if (c.seed >= 0 && isBetter(c.cardinality, c.seed, result)) {\n            result = c;\n        }\n    }\n    return result;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm. `owned` lists the seed indices this rank is\n// responsible for, in ascending order.\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const std::vector<int>& owned,\n                                  std::vector<DeviceWorker>& workers,\n                                  const int nranks) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<uint8_t> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    std::vector<int> active;\n    active.reserve(owned.size());\n    std::vector<int> gathered(2 * nranks);\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (true) {\n        // Unclustered seeds owned by this rank\n        active.clear();\n        for (int seed : owned) {\n            if (!clustered[seed]) active.push_back(seed);\n        }\n\n        // Best candidate over all ranks; every rank derives the same result\n        const Candidate local = evaluateActiveSeeds(workers, active, clustered, threshold);\n        const int send[2] = {local.cardinality, local.seed};\n        MPI_Allgather(send, 2, MPI_INT, gathered.data(), 2, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        Candidate best{-1, -1};\n        for (int r = 0; r < nranks; ++r) {\n            const Candidate c{gathered[2 * r], gathered[2 * r + 1]};\n            if (c.seed >= 0 && isBetter(c.cardinality, c.seed, best)) {\n                best = c;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // No more clusters can be formed\n        if (best.seed < 0 || best.cardinality <= 0) break;\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best.seed;\n        cluster.members = growCandidateCluster(best.seed, clustered, points, threshold);\n        if (static_cast<int>(cluster.members.size()) != best.cardinality) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"Internal error: device/host cluster cardinality mismatch\\n\");\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n\n        // Mark all members as clustered\n        for (int member : cluster.members) {\n            clustered[member] = 1;\n        }\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Diameters are independent per cluster, so compute them in parallel\n    std::vector<double> diameters(clusters.size(), 0.0);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic)\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Benchmark driver; runs identically on every rank, with output from rank 0 only\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv, int rank, int nranks) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Map ranks onto the GPUs of their node\n    MPI_Comm node_comm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &node_comm);\n    const std::vector<int> devices = selectDevices(node_comm);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&node_comm);\n\n    // Generate synthetic data (deterministic, so identical on every rank)\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n\n    // Cyclic distribution of seeds across ranks for load balance\n    std::vector<int> owned;\n    for (int i = rank; i < num_points; i += nranks) {\n        owned.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<DeviceWorker> workers = createWorkers(devices, points, owned.size());\n\n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold, owned, workers, nranks);\n\n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n\n    destroyWorkers(workers);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n        printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n    }\n\n    // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n    int total_clustered = 0;\n    int max_cluster_size = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n        const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n        total_clustered += size;\n        max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n    }\n\n    const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 :\n        static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\",\n               total_clustered, num_points,\n               100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n        printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n        printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n\n        // Performance metrics\n        const double time_sec = cluster_time.count() / 1000.0;\n        const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n        const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\",\n               clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults && root) {\n        // Serialize cluster membership for hashing\n        std::vector<double> membershipData;\n        membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n        std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n                membership[clusters[c].members[i]] = static_cast<int>(c);\n            }\n        }\n        for (int m : membership) {\n            membershipData.push_back(static_cast<double>(m));\n        }\n        print_results(membershipData, \"ClusterMembership\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation (performed on rank 0; Returns the members in\n// insertion order.\nstd::vector<int> growCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                                      const std::vector<uint8_t>& clustered,\n                                      const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                      const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n\n    // A negative value marks a point that can no longer be a candidate\n    std::vector<double> max_dist(N, 0.0);\n    for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n        if (clustered[c]) max_dist[c] = -1.0;\n    }\n    max_dist[seed_point] = -1.0;\n\n    std::vector<int> members{seed_point};\n    int added = seed_point;\n    while (true) {\n        for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n            if (max_dist[c] >= 0.0) {\n                max_dist[c] = std::max(max_dist[c], distance(points[c], points[added]));\n            }\n        }\n\n        int closest = -1;\n        double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n            if (max_dist[c] >= 0.0 && max_dist[c] < threshold && max_dist[c] < min_diameter) {\n                min_diameter = max_dist[c];\n                closest = c;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        members.push_back(closest);\n        max_dist[closest] = -1.0;\n        added = closest;\n    }\n\n    return members;\n}\n\n// Device-side counterpart of growCandidateCluster(): block b grows the candidate\n// cluster of seeds[b] and writes its cardinality to cardinalities[b].\n//\n// Only live candidates are visited at each step. Returns the members in\n// insertion order.\nstd::vector<int> growCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                                      const std::vector<uint8_t>& clustered,\n                                      const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                      const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n\n    // A negative value marks a point that can no longer be a candidate\n    std::vector<double> max_dist(N, 0.0);\n    for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n        if (clustered[c]) max_dist[c] = -1.0;\n    }\n    max_dist[seed_point] = -1.0;\n\n    std::vector<int> members{seed_point};\n    int added = seed_point;\n    while (true) {\n        for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n            if (max_dist[c] >= 0.0) {\n                max_dist[c] = std::max(max_dist[c], distance(points[c], points[added]));\n            }\n        }\n\n        int closest = -1;\n        double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n            if (max_dist[c] >= 0.0 && max_dist[c] < threshold && max_dist[c] < min_diameter) {\n                min_diameter = max_dist[c];\n                closest = c;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        members.push_back(closest);\n        max_dist[closest] = -1.0;\n        added = closest;\n    }\n\n    return members;\n}\n\n// Device-side counterpart of growCandidateCluster(): block b grows the candidate\n// cluster of seeds[b] and writes its cardinality to cardinalities[b].\n//\n// Only live candidates are visited at each step. candidates that stay admissible are kept for the next step\n        const Point& last = points[added];\n        const int len = live_len;\n        double best_dist = 0.0;\n        int best = -1;\n        for (int k = tid; k < len; k += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n            const int c = live[k];\n            if (c == added) continue; // The newest member is no longer a candidate\n\n            const double d = fmax(max_dist[c], distance(points[c], last));\n            max_dist[c] = d;\n            if (d < threshold) {\n                next[atomicAdd(&next_len, 1)] = c;\n                if (best < 0 || d < best_dist || (d == best_dist && c < best)) {\n                    best_dist = d;\n                    best = c;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        red_dist[tid] = best_dist;\n        red_idx[tid] = best;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Block-wide reduction: smallest distance wins, lowest index breaks ties\n        for (int s = BLOCK_SIZE / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n            if (tid < s) {\n                const int mi = red_idx[tid];\n                const int oi = red_idx[tid + s];\n                const double md = red_dist[tid];\n                const double od = red_dist[tid + s];\n                if (oi >= 0 && (mi < 0 || od < md || (od == md && oi < mi))) {\n                    red_dist[tid] = od;\n                    red_idx[tid] = oi;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        if (red_idx[0] < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            added = red_idx[0];\n            live_len = next_len;\n            next_len = 0;\n        }\n        cardinality++;\n        std::swap(live, next);\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) cardinalities[b] = cardinality;\n}\n\n// Per-GPU state, owned by exactly one OpenMP thread during evaluation\nstruct DeviceWorker {\n    int device = 0;\n    Point* d_points = nullptr;\n    uint8_t* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_cardinalities = nullptr;\n    double* d_scratch = nullptr;\n    int* d_lists = nullptr;\n    size_t batch_capacity = 0;\n    std::vector<int> h_cardinalities;\n};\n\n// Choose the GPUs this MPI rank drives. Ranks sharing a node split the node's\n// devices round-robin; every rank gets at least one device.\nstd::vector<int> selectDevices(MPI_Comm node_comm) {\n    int ndev = 0;\n int local_size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(node_comm, &local_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(node_comm, &local_size);\n\n    std::vector<int> devices;\n    for (int d = local_rank; d < ndev; d += local_size) Each\n//             round, every rank reports its best candidate seed and the\n//             global choice is made identically on all ranks (MPI_Allgather).\n//   - OpenMP: each rank drives all of its local GPUs with one host thread per\n//             device, and validation diameters are computed in parallel.\n//   - CUDA:   one thread block grows the candidate cluster of one seed; the\n//             per-step closest-point search is a block-wide reduction.\n//\n// Arithmetic and tie-breaking follow the sequential algorithm exactly, so the\n// clusters produced are identical to the sequential version.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <utility>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                   \\\n    do {                                                                   \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                         \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                         \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__, \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                             \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                  \\\n        }                                                                  \\\n    } while (0)\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Threads per block for the candidate-growth kernel (must be a power of two)\nconstexpr int BLOCK_SIZE = 256;\n\n// Upper bound on per-device scratch memory used for candidate distance state\nconstexpr size_t SCRATCH_BUDGET_BYTES = size_t{256} << 20;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Best candidate found so far: a cluster cardinality and the seed producing it\nstruct Candidate {\n    int cardinality;\n    int seed;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Squared Euclidean distance. Shared by host and device code so that both\n// evaluate exactly the same floating-point expression.\n__host__ __device__ inline double squaredDistance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return dx * dx + dy * dy;\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\n__host__ __device__ inline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    return sqrt(squaredDistance(p1, p2));\n}\n\n// Grow a candidate cluster from seed_point. At each step the unclustered point\n// with the smallest maximum distance to the current members is added (lowest\n// index wins ties), as long as that maximum distance is below the threshold.\n// max_dist[c] is maintained incrementally, which yields exactly the value that\n// a full recomputation over all members would give. Returns the members in\n// insertion order.\nstd::vector<int> growCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                                      const std::vector<uint8_t>& clustered,\n                                      const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                      const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n\n    // A negative value marks a point that can no longer be a candidate\n    std::vector<double> max_dist(N, 0.0);\n    for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n        if (clustered[c]) max_dist[c] = -1.0;\n    }\n    max_dist[seed_point] = -1.0;\n\n    std::vector<int> members{seed_point};\n    int added = seed_point;\n    while (true) {\n        for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n            if (max_dist[c] >= 0.0) {\n                max_dist[c] = std::max(max_dist[c], distance(points[c], points[added]));\n            }\n        }\n\n        int closest = -1;\n        double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n            if (max_dist[c] >= 0.0 && max_dist[c] < threshold && max_dist[c] < min_diameter) {\n                min_diameter = max_dist[c];\n                closest = c;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        members.push_back(closest);\n        max_dist[closest] = -1.0;\n        added = closest;\n    }\n\n    return members;\n}\n\n// Device-side counterpart of growCandidateCluster(): block b grows the candidate\n// cluster of seeds[b] and writes its cardinality to cardinalities[b]. Working\n// state for block b lives in max_dist_scratch[b * N ... b * N + N - 1].\n__global__ void candidateCardinalityKernel(const Point* points, const uint8_t* clustered,\n                                           const int N, const double threshold,\n                                           const int* seeds, double* max_dist_scratch,\n                                           int* cardinalities) {\n    __shared__ double red_dist[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int red_idx[BLOCK_SIZE];\n    __shared__ int added;\n\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int seed = seeds[b];\n    double* max_dist = max_dist_scratch + static_cast<size_t>(b) * N;\n\n    for (int c = tid; c < N; c += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        max_dist[c] = (clustered[c] || c == seed) ? -1.0 : 0.0;\n    }\n    if (tid == 0) added = seed;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    int cardinality = 1;\n    while (true) {\n        // Fold the most recently added member into every candidate's max distance\n        const Point& last = points[added];\n        for (int c = tid; c < N; c += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n            if (max_dist[c] >= 0.0) {\n                max_dist[c] = fmax(max_dist[c], distance(points[c], last));\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Per-thread search for the closest admissible candidate\n        double best_dist = 0.0;\n        int best = -1;\n        for (int c = tid; c < N; c += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n            const double d = max_dist[c];\n            if (d >= 0.0 && d < threshold &&\n                (best < 0 || d < best_dist || (d == best_dist && c < best))) {\n                best_dist = d;\n                best = c;\n            }\n        }\n        red_dist[tid] = best_dist;\n        red_idx[tid] = best;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Block-wide reduction: smallest distance wins, lowest index breaks ties\n        for (int s = BLOCK_SIZE / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n            if (tid < s) {\n                const int mi = red_idx[tid];\n                const int oi = red_idx[tid + s];\n                const double md = red_dist[tid];\n                const double od = red_dist[tid + s];\n                if (oi >= 0 && (mi < 0 || od < md || (od == md && oi < mi))) {\n                    red_dist[tid] = od;\n                    red_idx[tid] = oi;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        if (red_idx[0] < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            added = red_idx[0];\n            max_dist[added] = -1.0;\n        }\n        cardinality++;\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) cardinalities[b] = cardinality;\n}\n\n// Upper bound on the cardinality of the candidate cluster of seeds[b]: every\n// member other than the seed lies strictly within the threshold of the seed, so\n// 1 + (number of such unclustered points) bounds the cluster size.\n__global__ void neighborhoodBoundKernel(const Point* points, const uint8_t* clustered,\n                                        const int N, const double threshold,\n                                        const int* seeds, int* bounds) {\n    __shared__ int count;\n\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int seed = seeds[b];\n\n    if (tid == 0) count = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    int local = 0;\n    for (int c = tid; c < N; c += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n        if (!clustered[c] && c != seed && distance(points[c], points[seed]) < threshold) {\n            local++;\n        }\n    }\n    atomicAdd(&count, local);\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    if (tid == 0) bounds[b] = count + 1;\n}\n\n// Per-GPU state, owned by exactly one OpenMP thread during evaluation\nstruct DeviceWorker {\n    int device = 0;\n    Point* d_points = nullptr;\n    uint8_t* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_cardinalities = nullptr;\n    double* d_scratch = nullptr;\n    size_t batch_capacity = 0;\n    std::vector<int> h_cardinalities;\n};\n\n// Choose the GPUs this MPI rank drives. Ranks sharing a node split the node's\n// devices round-robin; every rank gets at least one device.\nstd::vector<int> selectDevices(MPI_Comm node_comm) {\n    int ndev = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&ndev));\n    if (ndev == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    int local_rank = 0;\n    int local_size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(node_comm, &local_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(node_comm, &local_size);\n\n    std::vector<int> devices;\n    for (int d = local_rank; d < ndev; d += local_size) {\n        devices.push_back(d);\n    }\n    if (devices.empty()) {\n        devices.push_back(local_rank % ndev);\n    }\n    return devices;\n}\n\n// Allocate device buffers and upload the (read-only) point set to each device\nstd::vector<DeviceWorker> createWorkers(const std::vector<int>& devices,\n                                        const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                        const size_t max_owned) {\n    const size_t N = points.size();\n    const size_t max_batch = std::max<size_t>(1, SCRATCH_BUDGET_BYTES / (N * sizeof(double)));\n    const size_t batch = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min(max_batch, max_owned));\n\n    std::vector<DeviceWorker> workers(devices.size());\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < devices.size(); ++t) {\n        DeviceWorker& w = workers[t];\n        w.device = devices[t];\n        w.batch_capacity = batch;\n        w.h_cardinalities.assign(batch, 0);\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(w.device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&w.d_points, N * sizeof(Point)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&w.d_clustered, N * sizeof(uint8_t)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&w.d_seeds, batch * sizeof(int)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&w.d_cardinalities, batch * sizeof(int)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&w.d_scratch, batch * N * sizeof(double)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(w.d_points, points.data(), N * sizeof(Point), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n    return workers;\n}\n\nvoid destroyWorkers(std::vector<DeviceWorker>& workers) {\n    for (DeviceWorker& w : workers) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(w.device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(w.d_points));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(w.d_clustered));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(w.d_seeds));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(w.d_cardinalities));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(w.d_scratch));\n    }\n}\n\n// True if (card, seed) should replace the current best: larger cardinality wins\n// and ties go to the lower seed index, matching the sequential scan order\ninline bool isBetter(const int cardinality, const int seed, const Candidate& best) {\n    return cardinality > best.cardinality ||\n           (cardinality == best.cardinality && seed < best.seed);\n}\n\n// Evaluate the cardinality of the candidate cluster for every seed in `active`,\n// split across this rank's GPUs (one OpenMP thread per device), and return the\n// best candidate found.\nCandidate evaluateActiveSeeds(std::vector<DeviceWorker>& workers,\n                              const std::vector<int>& active,\n                              const std::vector<uint8_t>& clustered,\n                              const double threshold) {\n    Candidate result{-1, -1};\n    if (active.empty()) return result;\n\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(clustered.size());\n    const int T = static_cast<int>(workers.size());\n    const size_t n = active.size();\n    std::vector<Candidate> per_worker(T, Candidate{-1, -1});\n\n    #pragma omp parallel num_threads(T)\n    {\n        const int t = omp_get_thread_num();\n        DeviceWorker& w = workers[t];\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(w.device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(w.d_clustered, clustered.data(), N * sizeof(uint8_t),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        const size_t lo = n * t / T;\n        const size_t hi = n * (t + 1) / T;\n        const size_t count = hi - lo;\n\n        // Cardinality upper bound of each seed, computed on the device\n        // (d_cardinalities is reused as scratch for the bounds)\n        std::vector<int> bound(count);\n        for (size_t off = 0; off < count; off += w.batch_capacity) {\n            const int m = static_cast<int>(std::min(w.batch_capacity, count - off));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(w.d_seeds, active.data() + lo + off, m * sizeof(int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            neighborhoodBoundKernel<<<m, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(w.d_points, w.d_clustered, N, threshold,\n                                                       w.d_seeds, w.d_cardinalities);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(bound.data() + off, w.d_cardinalities, m * sizeof(int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        // Visit seeds by decreasing bound (ties: lower seed first). Once a seed\n        // cannot beat the best candidate, no later seed can either.\n        std::vector<size_t> order(count);\n        std::iota(order.begin(), order.end(), size_t{0});\n        std::sort(order.begin(), order.end(), [&](size_t a, size_t b) {\n            if (bound[a] != bound[b]) return bound[a] > bound[b];\n            return active[lo + a] < active[lo + b];\n        });\n\n        Candidate local{-1, -1};\n        std::vector<int> batch;\n        size_t pos = 0;\n        while (pos < count) {\n            // Gather the next batch of seeds that could still win\n            batch.clear();\n            while (pos < count && batch.size() < w.batch_capacity) {\n                const size_t i = order[pos];\n                const int seed = active[lo + i];\n                if (bound[i] < local.cardinality ||\n                    (bound[i] == local.cardinality && seed > local.seed)) {\n                    pos = count; // Every remaining seed is pruned as well\n                    break;\n                }\n                batch.push_back(seed);\n                ++pos;\n            }\n            if (batch.empty()) break;\n\n            const int m = static_cast<int>(batch.size());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(w.d_seeds, batch.data(), m * sizeof(int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            candidateCardinalityKernel<<<m, BLOCK_SIZE>>>(w.d_points, w.d_clustered, N, threshold,\n                                                          w.d_seeds, w.d_scratch,\n                                                          w.d_cardinalities);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(w.h_cardinalities.data(), w.d_cardinalities, m * sizeof(int),\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n            for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {\n                if (isBetter(w.h_cardinalities[i], batch[i], local)) {\n                    local = Candidate{w.h_cardinalities[i], batch[i]};\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        per_worker[t] = local;\n    }\n\n    for (const Candidate& c : per_worker) {\n        if (c.seed >= 0 && isBetter(c.cardinality, c.seed, result)) {\n            result = c;\n        }\n    }\n    return result;\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm. `owned` lists the seed indices this rank is\n// responsible for, in ascending order.\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const std::vector<int>& owned,\n                                  std::vector<DeviceWorker>& workers,\n                                  const int nranks) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<uint8_t> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    std::vector<int> active;\n    active.reserve(owned.size());\n    std::vector<int> gathered(2 * nranks);\n\n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (true) {\n        // Unclustered seeds owned by this rank\n        active.clear();\n        for (int seed : owned) {\n            if (!clustered[seed]) active.push_back(seed);\n        }\n\n        // Best candidate over all ranks; every rank derives the same result\n        const Candidate local = evaluateActiveSeeds(workers, active, clustered, threshold);\n        const int send[2] = {local.cardinality, local.seed};\n        MPI_Allgather(send, 2, MPI_INT, gathered.data(), 2, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        Candidate best{-1, -1};\n        for (int r = 0; r < nranks; ++r) {\n            const Candidate c{gathered[2 * r], gathered[2 * r + 1]};\n            if (c.seed >= 0 && isBetter(c.cardinality, c.seed, best)) {\n                best = c;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // No more clusters can be formed\n        if (best.seed < 0 || best.cardinality <= 0) break;\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = best.seed;\n        cluster.members = growCandidateCluster(best.seed, clustered, points, threshold);\n        if (static_cast<int>(cluster.members.size()) != best.cardinality) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"Internal error: device/host cluster cardinality mismatch\\n\");\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n\n        // Mark all members as clustered\n        for (int member : cluster.members) {\n            clustered[member] = 1;\n        }\n        clusters.push_back(std::move(cluster));\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Diameters are independent per cluster, so compute them in parallel\n    std::vector<double> diameters(clusters.size(), 0.0);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic)\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Benchmark driver; runs identically on every rank, with output from rank 0 only\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv, int rank, int nranks) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Map ranks onto the GPUs of their node\n    MPI_Comm node_comm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &node_comm);\n    const std::vector<int> devices = selectDevices(node_comm);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&node_comm);\n\n    // Generate synthetic data (deterministic, so identical on every rank)\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n\n    // Cyclic distribution of seeds across ranks for load balance\n    std::vector<int> owned;\n    for (int i = rank; i < num_points; i += nranks) {\n        owned.push_back(i);\n    }\n\n    std::vector<DeviceWorker> workers = createWorkers(devices, points, owned.size());\n\n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold, owned, workers, nranks);\n\n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n\n    destroyWorkers(workers);\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n        printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n    }\n\n    // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n    int total_clustered = 0;\n    int max_cluster_size = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n        const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n        total_clustered += size;\n        max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n    }\n\n    const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 :\n        static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\",\n               total_clustered, num_points,\n               100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n        printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n        printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n\n        // Performance metrics\n        const double time_sec = cluster_time.count() / 1000.0;\n        const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n        const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\",\n               clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults && root) {\n        // Serialize cluster membership for hashing\n        std::vector<double> membershipData;\n        membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n        std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n        for (size_t c = 0; };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Squared Euclidean distance. Returns the members in\n// insertion order.\nstd::vector<int> growCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                                      const std::vector<uint8_t>& clustered,\n                                      const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                      const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n\n    // A negative value marks a point that can no longer be a candidate\n    std::vector<double> max_dist(N, 0.0);\n    for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n        if (clustered[c]) max_dist[c] = -1.0;\n    }\n    max_dist[seed_point] = -1.0;\n\n    std::vector<int> members{seed_point};\n    int added = seed_point;\n    while (true) {\n        for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n            if (max_dist[c] >= 0.0) {\n                max_dist[c] = std::max(max_dist[c], distance(points[c], points[added]));\n            }\n        }\n\n        int closest = -1;\n        double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n        for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c) {\n            if (max_dist[c] >= 0.0 && max_dist[c] < threshold && max_dist[c] < min_diameter) {\n                min_diameter = max_dist[c];\n                closest = c;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        members.push_back(closest);\n        max_dist[closest] = -1.0;\n        added = closest;\n    }\n\n    return members;\n}\n\n// Device-side counterpart of growCandidateCluster(): block b grows the candidate\n// cluster of seeds[b] and writes its cardinality to cardinalities[b].\n//\n// Only live candidates are visited at each step. candidates that stay admissible are kept for the next step\n        const Point& last = points[added];\n        const int len = live_len;\n        double best_dist = 0.0;\n        int best = -1;\n        for (int k = tid; k < len; k += BLOCK_SIZE) {\n            const int c = live[k];\n            if (c == added) continue; // The newest member is no longer a candidate\n\n            const double d = fmax(max_dist[c], distance(points[c], last));\n            max_dist[c] = d;\n            if (d < threshold) {\n                next[atomicAdd(&next_len, 1)] = c;\n                if (best < 0 || d < best_dist || (d == best_dist && c < best)) {\n                    best_dist = d;\n                    best = c;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        red_dist[tid] = best_dist;\n        red_idx[tid] = best;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Block-wide reduction: smallest distance wins, lowest index breaks ties\n        for (int s = BLOCK_SIZE / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n            if (tid < s) {\n                const int mi = red_idx[tid];\n                const int oi = red_idx[tid + s];\n                const double md = red_dist[tid];\n                const double od = red_dist[tid + s];\n                if (oi >= 0 && (mi < 0 || od < md || (od == md && oi < mi))) {\n                    red_dist[tid] = od;\n                    red_idx[tid] = oi;\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        if (red_idx[0] < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            added = red_idx[0];\n            live_len = next_len;\n            next_len = 0;\n        }\n        cardinality++;\n        std::swap(live, next);\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) cardinalities[b] = cardinality;\n}\n\n// Per-GPU state, owned by exactly one OpenMP thread during evaluation\nstruct DeviceWorker {\n    int device = 0;\n    Point* d_points = nullptr;\n    uint8_t* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_cardinalities = nullptr;\n    double* d_scratch = nullptr;\n    int* d_lists = nullptr;\n    size_t batch_capacity = 0;\n    std::vector<int> h_cardinalities;\n};\n\n// Choose the GPUs this MPI rank drives. Ranks sharing a node split the node's\n// devices round-robin; every rank gets at least one device.\nstd::vector<int> selectDevices(MPI_Comm node_comm) {\n    int ndev = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&ndev));\n    if (ndev == 0) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA devices available\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n\n    int local_rank = 0;\n    int local_size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(node_comm, &local_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(node_comm, &local_size);\n\n    std::vector<int> devices;\n    for (int d = local_rank; d < ndev; d += local_size) (read-only) point set to each device\nstd::vector<DeviceWorker> createWorkers(const std::vector<int>& devices,\n                                        const std::vector<Point>& points,\n sizeof(int)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&w.d_scratch, batch * N * sizeof(double)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&w.d_lists, batch * 2 * N * sizeof(int)));\n CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(w.d_seeds));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(w.d_cardinalities));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(w.d_scratch));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(w.d_lists));\n    }\n}\n\n// True if (card, Candidate result{-1, -1};\n    if (active.empty()) return result;\n\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(clustered.size());\n    const int T = static_cast<int>(workers.size());\n    const size_t n = qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const std::vector<int>& owned,\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfzPqpHbDyaaJSfh6ndRG","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA version builds and reproduces the original's output exactly, and it is 230× to 700× faster on the sizes I could time against the original.\n\n**Results**\n\n- **Correctness:** the `-r` membership hash matches the original on every configuration I tried: the four reference configs plus 36 sweep cases (N ∈ {31, 50, 300}, thresholds 0.3–5.0), at 1, 2, 3, 5 and 7 ranks. The `-v` validation passes in all cases I ran.\n- **Speed (single rank, 4 GPUs):**\n\n| Config | Original | New |\n|---|---|---|\n| N=1000, t=2.0 | 7019 ms | 30 ms |\n| N=2000, t=1.5 | 55033 ms | 81 ms |\n| N=4000, t=1.0 | not measured | 207 ms |\n| N=8000, t=1.0 | not measured | 648 ms (440 ms on 4 ranks) |\n\nThe 4-rank run on N=8000 is only about 1.5× faster than the single rank. The likely limit is GPU FP64 throughput on these consumer RTX 3090s plus per-iteration synchronisation. I did not profile it further.\n\n**What changed**\n\n- **Algorithm (exact):** the candidate distance is maintained incrementally, so growing a cluster is O(M·N) instead of O(M²·N). The CUDA kernel also keeps a live list and drops candidates once their max distance reaches the threshold, which is safe because that distance never decreases. This gave the biggest single gain (about 6× at N=8000).\n- **MPI:** seeds are distributed cyclically across ranks. Each round, `MPI_Allgather` picks the global best using the original tie-break (largest cardinality, then lowest seed index).\n- **CUDA:** one thread block grows the candidate cluster for one seed, with a block-wide argmin reduction. Host and device share one `__host__ __device__` distance function.\n- **OpenMP:** one host thread per local GPU, and the per-cluster diameter validation runs in parallel.\n- **CMake:** `project(... LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)`, `find_package` for MPI, OpenMP and CUDAToolkit with `REQUIRED`, and the `.cpp` is compiled as CUDA. It requires CMake ≥ 3.24. `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` defaults to `native` unless set. The executable name is unchanged.\n\n**Choices I made that you may want to change**\n\n- Both host and device compile with FMA contraction off (`-ffp-contract=off`, `--fmad=false`). Without this, host and device distances could differ in the last bit. It still matches the original's output on every test, but the original was built with contraction on, so the bit-level arithmetic is not identical to the original binary.\n- Ranks on a node split that node's GPUs round-robin. Every rank gets at least one device.\n- Rank 0 does the printing and the validation. The validation result is broadcast so all ranks exit with the same status.\n- Pruning by a cardinality upper bound was tried and reverted because it did not reduce work.\n\n**Things I noticed but did not change**\n\n- The synthetic generator never places a point when N ≤ 30, so the original and the new program both hang for those sizes. The `-v` validation passes in all cases I ran.\n- **Speed (single rank, 4 GPUs):**\n\n| Config | Original | New |\n|---|---|---|\n| N=1000, t=2.0 | 7019 ms | 30 ms |\n| N=2000, t=1.5 | 55033 ms | 81 ms |\n| N=4000, t=1.0 | not measured | 207 ms |\n| N=8000, t=1.0 | not measured | 648 ms (440 ms on 4 ranks) |\n\nThe 4-rank run on N=8000 is only about 1.5× faster than the single rank. The likely limit is GPU FP64 throughput on these consumer RTX 3090s plus per-iteration synchronisation. I did not profile it further.\n\n**What changed**\n\n- **Algorithm (exact):** the candidate distance is maintained incrementally, so growing a cluster is O(M·N) instead of O(M²·N). The CUDA kernel also keeps a live list and drops candidates once their max distance reaches the threshold, which is safe because that distance never decreases. This gave the biggest single gain (about 6× at N=8000).\n- **MPI:** seeds are distributed cyclically across ranks. Each round, `MPI_Allgather` picks the global best using the original tie-break (largest cardinality, then lowest seed index).\n- **CUDA:** one thread block grows the candidate cluster for one seed, with a block-wide argmin reduction. Host and device share one `__host__ __device__` distance function.\n- **OpenMP:** one host thread per local GPU, and the per-cluster diameter validation runs in parallel.\n- **CMake:** `project(... LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)`, `find_package` for MPI, OpenMP and CUDAToolkit with `REQUIRED`, and the `.cpp` is compiled as CUDA. It requires CMake ≥ 3.24. `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` defaults to `native` unless set. The executable name is unchanged.\n\n**Choices I made that you may want to change**\n\n- Both host and device compile with FMA contraction off (`-ffp-contract=off`, `--fmad=false`). Without this, host and device distances could differ in the last bit. It still matches the original's output on every test, but the original was built with contraction on, so the bit-level arithmetic is not identical to the original binary.\n- Ranks on a node split that node's GPUs round-robin. Every rank gets at least one device.\n- Rank 0 does the printing and the validation. The validation result is broadcast so all ranks exit with the same status.\n- Pruning by a cardinality upper bound was tried and reverted because it did not reduce work.\n\n**Things I noticed but did not change**\n\n- The synthetic generator never places a point when N ≤ 30, so the original and the new program both hang for those sizes. This is pre-existing behaviour in `generateSyntheticData`.\n- I ran everything through `mpirun` only.
